title: 계획 말하기: 이번 주말, 다음 주, 내년에 뭐 해요?
objective: By the end, you can use words like 계획, 다음 주, 내년, 방학, and 여행 in short sentences that say when you will do something and what you plan to do.
summary: Learn ten everyday words for talking about plans, such as weekends, vacations, trips, and next year.

task.title: Use the plan words
task.line: Read each item, then choose, fill in, order, or answer using the words from page 1.

words.exampleMeaning: Do you have any plans for the weekend?
I'm planning to meet a friend next week.
I'm planning to come back to Korea next year.
When does your school vacation start?
Where are you going on your trip?
On weekends, I usually rest at home.
This year, I want to study Korean hard.

words.meaning: this (coming or current) one, as in this weekend or this vacation
time off from work, a vacation (for workers)
words.exampleMeaning: How many days off did you get?

exercises: Choose the right word (방학 / 휴가): ① 학생들은 여름 ____에 학교에 안 가요. ② 회사원 민수 씨는 다음 달에 일주일 ____를 받아요.
Fill in each blank with 이번, 올해, or 다음 주. Use each word once: ① 오늘은 금요일이에요. ____ 주말에 등산을 하려고 해요. ② 지금은 3월이에요. ____ 12월에 한국에 가요. ③ 이번 주는 너무 바빠요. ____에 만나요.
Read and answer in English: 미나: 이번 방학에 뭐 해요? / 준: 고향에 가려고 해요. 가족이 보고 싶어요. — Where is Jun going this vacation, and why?
Put the words in order to make a sentence. Start with 내년에 and put 일본으로 second: 여행을 / 내년에 / 일본으로 / 가려고 해요
Fill in the blanks with 계획 and 여행: 가: 겨울 방학에 무슨 ____이 있어요? 나: 친구하고 태국 ____을 가려고 해요.
Which word is a place, not a time? 주말 / 고향 / 내년 / 방학
answers: ① 이번 ② 올해 ③ 다음 주
He is going to his hometown, because he misses his family.
